_: The update card's changelog. Newest first. Each entry: build (the stamp it shipped as), title, notes. newsSince() shows entries until it meets the running build — keep this list short and honest.

entries.title: Your hand bends the world now
notes: the touch no longer draws anything on top of the visuals — it deforms the space they live in, and everything obeys
the black hole is genuinely dark because light near it stops coming back, and the bright ring around it is real lensing
hold your finger down and the horizon widens; let go and a wavefront leaves your fingertip and travels out
scenes with no particles answer your touch for the first time — the light itself is bent, so every scene reacts
reduced motion keeps the touch alive at a gentler strength instead of switching it off

entries.title: The auto-mix holds its beat lock
notes: the intermittent glitch in the auto mix is fixed — blends stayed in time on an idle machine and drifted up to a quarter beat when the visuals were working hard
the seam is now lined up against where the outgoing track actually is, so a busy frame can no longer cost a blend its timing
the incoming track is given a moment to get rolling before the fader opens, so a blend starts full instead of easing in from nothing
measured under full visual load: beat error down from 114 ms to under 8 ms, and it is now a test that has to keep passing

entries.title: Shorter, tighter blends
notes: auto-mix now blends in 8 beats by default instead of 32 — a punchier mix, and far less room for two decks to drift apart
the crate's match scores now rate the PAIR (key and tempo) rather than rewarding whichever blend was longest
longer blends are still there per pair in the Mix tuner

entries.title: The Update button, fixed — and a log of what the app does
notes: tapping Update always does something now: if another window already applied it, this one reloads instead of going quiet
"Later" is remembered across restarts — the button keeps a count and reminds you once when the time is up
SHOW mode still holds every update; nothing is ever applied out from under a set
new Activity log at the bottom of the Console: updates, what played, what the system decided — kept on this device only

entries.title: Colour that survives the brightest moment
notes: bright scenes no longer wash out to white — overdriven light reads as deeper colour instead
blowing out to white is saved for the drop, where the music has earned it
the palette is now a full gradient, so sweeps stay vivid instead of going grey in the middle
click the three colour dots in the HUD: AUTO · SPECTRUM · DUOTONE

entries.title: Four more skins
notes: Sakura Night, Solstice, Ultramarine, Garnet & Silver — 12 in all
dialogs, the update bar, and the welcome card now follow your skin too

entries.title: Skins + a bulletproof update bar
notes: 8 skins — dress the whole console; your pick stays on this device
the welcome says it plainly: a free jukebox, loaded and ready
updating shows an honest progress bar that never gets stuck
if a swap ever stalls, the player hands itself back — nothing lost

entries.title: Smart self-updating
notes: updates now arrive by themselves — no more clearing site data
the Update button wears a badge and opens this log
choose: now, after this track, or later (6 h)
⚡ SHOW mode is never interrupted by an update

entries.title: The epic touch
notes: hold to charge, release to detonate
sling the vortex and it keeps spinning
tap on the beat — the field answers louder
✦ AUTO: scenes re-tune your touch as they change

entries.title: Echoes — passing thoughts
notes: quotes drift by like clouds in the calm passages
✧ MUSE floats questions you can answer, kept on this device only

entries.title: Power modes
notes: ⚡ SHOW: full density, screen kept awake
⚡ ECO: half the frames, quarter the pixels — battery goes to the music

entries.title: Mobile booth redesign
notes: real platters on mobile, a live monitor between them
